git:index/getPatch:getPatch.description: Resolves a single patch: a local file, inline diff content, or a remote host source (e.g. a GitHub PR/commit or a GitLab MR/commit). Exactly one of `content`, `file`, `github`, or `gitlab` must be set. Does not clone, apply, commit, or push; that is `git.Branch`'s responsibility.

inputs.description: A collection of arguments for invoking getPatch.

auth.description: Authentication details used to call the GitHub or GitLab API when `github` or `gitlab` is set.

file.description: Path to a local patch file, read on refresh.

github.description: Resolves the patch from a GitHub pull request or commit. Exactly one of `pr` or `commit` must be set.

gitlab.description: Resolves the patch from a GitLab merge request or commit. Exactly one of `mr` or `commit` must be set.

outputs.description: A collection of values returned by getPatch.

auth.description: Authentication details used to call the GitHub or GitLab API when `github` or `gitlab` is set.

diff.description: Resolved unified diff content, from whichever of `content`, `file`, or `github` was set.

gitlab.description: Resolves the patch from a GitLab merge request or commit. Exactly one of `mr` or `commit` must be set.

id.description: Stable identifier for the patch: the hex-encoded sha256 of the resolved `diff`.
